## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see added to VoluMaph.

## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Why is it needed?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like to see. Include:
- How the feature should work
- User interface changes (if any)
- Expected behavior

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered:
- Why they weren't suitable
- What advantages/disadvantages they have

## Additional Context

Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.

## Mockups

If you have mockups or design ideas, please attach them here:

![Mockup description](image_url)

## Priority

How important is this feature to you?
- [ ] Critical - Must have
- [ ] High - Very important
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Optional

## Implementation Ideas

If you have ideas on how this could be implemented, please share them. This helps maintainers understand your vision:

```csharp
// Pseudocode or implementation ideas
```

## Related Issues

- Related to #(issue number)
- References #(issue number)

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues for similar feature requests
- [ ] I have described the problem this feature solves
- [ ] I have provided a clear description of the proposed solution
- [ ] I have considered alternatives
- [ ] I am willing to help implement this feature (optional)
